Career Profile

I have worked in the software development industry for over 15 years as an Engineer on PC, console and mobile game titles and native mobile apps.

My main areas of expertise is tool development, workflow improvement, R&D, realtime 3D graphics shading and rendering, game engine programming and art production pipeline improvement.

Being very passionate about game development, I like creating new technology, and improving the way people work individually and together.

Graphics Research

2025/03 ~ Present
RebrightFX - Cinematic High Definition Image Detail Enhancing Shader Post Effect

As a part of my private graphics research, I developed a real-time, complex cinematic shader post effect for enhancing graphics image quality, with the aim of improving visuals for games, films, shows, animation and digital images. The goal was to create at least 2 products, one for home use to visually enhance personal game and movie libraries, and another aimed at use in game engines for game development. I wanted to make scenes and images stand out with clearer, sharper, more beautiful visuals, and give it an increased sense of realism with graphics features like:

Light Enhanced appearance of light and illumination, to give it a more bright, vibrant, emissive photonic glow that looks closer to real world light, instead of the current flat, dull approximations or captures.
Shadow Improved self shadowing, to improve contours and give a better visual sense of object shape and definition.
Visual Perception Improved visual perception and sense of object space, depth, and distance between objects, to improve visual realism and improve natural human eye focus and tracking of objects when looking at digital media.
Clarity Improved image clarity, sharpness and fidelity, to make it look as clear as glass, as if like looking through a window to another world.
Detail Improved image details and micro-details, to enhance it to finer, sharper, higher definition detail levels
Cinematic Look Cinematic effects like multiple bloom techniques for enhancing illumination, and multiple tonemapping techniques for improved contrast, deep shadows, and a more vibrant look.
Color Improved color tones and hues, to make colors richer, deeper and more vibrant.

Please see my Youtube Channel for video samples.
My Youtube Channel link can also be found at the top right of this resume in the sidebar.

The home use version of RebrightFX is almost ready for release.
Work on the game engine versions will commence after funding is secured for further development.
